scripts.opencode:turbo:check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='opencode.json';const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const modelOk=c.model==='turboquant/gemma4-tq'&&c.small_model==='turboquant/gemma4-tq';const provider=(c.provider||{}).turboquant;const base=provider&&provider.options&&provider.options.baseURL;const ollamaDisabled=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call((c.provider||{}),'ollama_disabled')&&!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call((c.provider||{}),'ollama');if(!modelOk||base!=='http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1'||!ollamaDisabled){console.error('OpenCode TurboQuant wiring check failed');console.error(JSON.stringify({model:c.model,small_model:c.small_model,baseURL:base,providerKeys:Object.keys(c.provider||{})},null,2));process.exit(1);}console.log('OpenCode TurboQuant wiring OK');"
